messages:
ellie-partnerships: Heads-up: CloudForge (SI) + StormPeak (partner) want Redwood in their GCP Marketplace entry for a new sovereign nodepool in eu-central-2. They need committed capacity, billing SKU mapping, and KMS/HSM proof for the marketplace listing. Target: pilot in 10 business days. Anyone object?

kevin-sales: No objections from sales. StormPeak expects 4x A2 + 1x H100 reserved for the pilot, with auto-burst to spare capacity. They want volume discounts on dedicated capacity.

tom-cloud: Opened GCP marketplace quota ticket MKT-9910 yesterday. GCP asked for billing SKU mapping and a sample invoice flow. ETA 3-4 business days.

nora-ops: For infra: need subnet ranges, NAT egress limits, and private service connect setup. Also request for an ops playbook for region failover.

ravi-security: Compliance ask: sovereign region must enforce key ownership via customer-managed keys (CMK) in HSM-backed KeyVault. We'll need architecture diagram + attestation from StormPeak/HSM vendor. Also confirm audit log routing doesn't cross borders.

ellie-partnerships: StormPeak sent a draft architecture + cost sheet: https://stormpeak.example/pilot-euc2-costs (internal). They also propose SLO alignment doc and a joint press window.

infra-bot: [quota-bot] Ticket MKT-9910 created. Status: AWAITING_GCP_REVIEW. Attach: sku-mapping.csv, sample-invoice.pdf.

tom-cloud: I added a mapping for our billing SKUs to their marketplace SKUs. PR: https://git.redwood/billing/marketplace-mappings/pulls/87. Please review.

nora-ops: Two technical questions for StormPeak: (1) can they accept Private Service Connect endpoints? (2) do they have automation for cert rotation if we use mutual TLS for SI APIs?

kevin-sales: StormPeak confirmed PSC support and said they already have a rotation webhook for certs. They want cert TTL of 30 days.

ravi-security: Cert TTL 30 days is fine if rotation is automated and we keep a 48h overlap. We still need an attestation from their HSM vendor about key residency and zero-export guarantees.

ellie-partnerships: Action items: 1) tom-cloud: push GCP quota attachments + invoice flow to MKT-9910 (owner). 2) nora-ops: draft ops playbook + failure mode steps (owner). 3) ravi-security: request HSM attestation + confirm audit routing (owner). 4) kevin-sales: negotiate discount language with StormPeak and capture in partner addendum. Deadlines: 48h for items 1-3, 72h for item 4.

tom-cloud: Will attach billing mapping and the example invoice to the GCP ticket today.

nora-ops: I'll start the ops playbook skeleton in the repo: https://git.redwood/ops/region-playbooks/tree/euc2.
Key sections: provisioning, network, canary rollout, health checks, rollback.

ravi-security: Pinged StormPeak for HSM attestation and asked for their SOC2/HSM vendor docs.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: new marketplace listing requires preflight: quotas, billing mapping, KMS proof, SI onboarding sign-off, legal marketing review. Use /marketplace-preflight when ready.

kevin-sales: I'll get a draft partner addendum by Friday. Can someone add the proposed discount tiers to the spreadsheet?

ellie-partnerships: Done — added a Discounts tab in their sheet. Also proposed an embargo date for joint announcement: 2025-06-02 09:00 UTC. Please flag any legal concerns.

ravi-security: Legal will need to sign the announcement; also want explicit language about data flows and key custody in the addendum.

nora-ops: FYI, I've added a fallback nodepool mapping so if H100 capacity isn't available we automatically spin from A2 pool and tag requests with `marketplace_fallback=true`. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/region-nodepools/pulls/29.

tom-cloud: GCP updated MKT-9910 -> LIMIT_INCREASE_APPROVED. Still waiting for KMS proof and HSM attestation to finalize marketplace publishing.

ellie-partnerships: Great. Let's hold a go/no-go on Monday standup if HSM attestation comes through. If anything slips, we'll move pilot by one week.

kevin-sales: StormPeak is OK with flexible pilot delay. They're focused on ensuring the HSM attestation is explicit in the listing.

ravi-security: Attestation arrived via email from HSM vendor; storing in secure drive and pushing to ticket. Will share redacted copy in this thread.

infra-bot: [incident-bot] No incidents linked.

ellie-partnerships: Closing summary: quotas approved, nodepool fallback in PR, HSM attestation received, addendum in progress. Owners — please update your tasks and I'll create the calendar invite for the pilot kickoff. :rocket:
